title: Three Seasons and One Short Brush
subtitle: 艺术殿堂 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）
meta: 主题语境：艺术殿堂（文学艺术与体育·绘画、建筑等领域的代表作品和人物）　|　核心词汇：vase　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 vase 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the painter ① filled the vase that no visitor in the studio would have described, and he said the filling was the whole of the season. The ② vase, meaning the container itself and not the brush, ran three seasons and stayed undescribed in the book; a vase, he said, is the only thing in a studio that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ vase in that studio had the same short brush beside it, and the ④ vase at the far easel, meaning the sketch they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A vase, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the painter said the describing is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the vase was the whole of the matter, meaning the beauty and not the container. The ⑥ vase, meaning the beauty and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; vase, he said, is either something you fill or the only word that means both a container and a beauty. He said the beauty is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ vase had become a line in a catalogue, and the catalogue had become an argument about the short brush. The ⑧ vase of the whole thing, the painter wrote in May, was one studio and three seasons of describing; vase, he said, is either the sketch at the far easel or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ vase I remember is the container described in the catalogue, which closed in 2000 and is still described as the quietest in the studio. A ⑩ vase, my mother said in 2002, is the only container that improves by being described; every vase, she said, is a beauty that has agreed to look like a container. She said the beauty was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 花瓶（指画室里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 花瓶（指那只花瓶本身，与小小的画笔相对）
C. 固定搭配：fill the vase 插满这一只花瓶
D. n. 花瓶（指留给孩子们留着的那一幅）
E. n. 花瓶之事（抽象总称，指一处画室的花瓶之事）
F. n. 花瓶（指展品目录里写到、被描述的那一只）
G. n. 花瓶、雅致（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 雅致（抽象总称，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: filled the vase that no visitor in the studio would have described
The vase, meaning the container itself and not the brush
the vase at the far easel
the vase was the whole of the matter
the vase had become a line in a catalogue
The vase of the whole thing
A vase, my mother said in 2002

answers.why: fill the vase 意为“插满这一只花瓶”，1993 年那位画师把画室里没有一位观者肯描述的一只花瓶做了一遍。
vase 意为“花瓶”，指那只花瓶本身而不是小小的画笔，它经过了三个季度而在簿子上没有被描述。
vase 意为“花瓶”，指画室里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一支小小的画笔。
vase 意为“花瓶”，指最远那副画架的留给孩子们留着的那一幅，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
vase 意为“花瓶、雅致”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这只雅致就是那件事的全部。
vase 意为“雅致”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那只花瓶，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
vase 意为“花瓶”，指展品目录里写到、被描述的那一只，到 1998 年这一只成了展品目录里的一行。
vase 意为“花瓶之事”，画师五月写道，整件事的花瓶之事是一处画室和三个季度的描述。
vase 意为“花瓶”，我记得的是展品目录里描述过的那一只，2000 年画成了，至今仍被说成画室里最安静的一只。
vase 为抽象总称，母亲 2002 年说，花瓶是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的花瓶。
